place.zh: 沉鼎观 · 大比 · 第一轮
place.en: Chending Temple · The contest · Round one

setup.zh: 第一轮，你的对手是孙二狗。他上台的时候，腿在抖：「咱俩……都是下下之资……你手下留情……」
setup.en: Round one: your opponent is Sun Ergou. His legs shake as he climbs up. "We're both… the bottom of the class… go easy on me…"

recap.zh: 大比第一轮，你的对手是孙二狗。
recap.en: In the first round of the contest you faced Sun Ergou.

zh: 他腿在抖。腰上，他娘缝的护身符。
en: His legs shake. At his waist, the charm his mother sewed.

story.zh:
孙二狗便是上山路上，在那个漏风的牛棚里分到小满半张饼的那个瘦高个儿，灵根比小满还差，进门三个月，什么都没引着，连打他的人都没有——打他实在没有意思。上台的时候，他腿在抖，一看对手是小满，抖得更厉害了——倒不是怕，是松了一口气，松得太猛，腿便软了。他挨过来，压低了声音：「沈……沈师兄……咱俩都是下下之资……你手下留情……」小满也压低了声音：「你先出手。」

小满瞧见他腰里系着一个小小的布包，蓝布的，四个角缝得方方正正，针脚密得像蚂蚁排队，一针挨着一针，连一根头发丝也插不进去。小满他娘也是缝东西的好手，他看得多了，一眼便估得出：这样的针脚，这样大的一块，是油灯底下三个晚上的活，一个晚上缝一个角，第四个角缝到天亮。

那是一个护身符。
story.en:
Sun Ergou was the lanky boy who'd shared half of Xiaoman's flatbread in the drafty cowshed on the way up the mountain. His roots were worse than Xiaoman's; three months in the gate he'd drawn nothing in, and nobody even bothered to beat him — beating him was no fun. Coming up onto the stage his legs shook, and seeing his opponent was Xiaoman they shook harder — not from fear, but from relief, so much relief his legs went soft. He edged closer and whispered: "Sh… Brother Shen… we're both the bottom grade… go easy on me…" Xiaoman whispered back: "You hit first."

Xiaoman saw a little cloth pouch at his waist, blue, its four corners sewn square, the stitches close as a line of ants, one against the next so tight not a hair could pass between. Xiaoman's mother was a fine hand with a needle too, and he'd watched enough to judge at a glance: stitches like these, a piece this size, three nights' work under an oil lamp, a corner a night, the fourth sewn till dawn.

It was a charm.

exits.means: loses on purpose, lets Sun Ergou win

refuse.zh: 你看着孙二狗发抖的腿。你不知道他为什么这么想赢一场。
refuse.en: You look at Sun Ergou's shaking legs. You don't know why he wants one win so badly.

what.zh: 外门大比第一轮，你往后一倒，让孙二狗赢了他入观以来的第一场。
what.en: Round one of the contest: you fell backwards and let Sun Ergou win the first bout of his life in the temple.

story.zh:
孙二狗闭上眼睛，一拳打了过来。那一拳软绵绵的，离小满鼻尖还差着老大一截，小满已「哎呀——」一声大叫，往后便倒，四仰八叉地摔出了台子，连台下的尘土都扬起来半尺高。

台下一片寂静，跟着便是一阵哄笑，笑得最响的是马小宝，桂花糕渣子喷了前头人一后脑勺：「我就说！五行杂灵根，连个零层都打不过！」孙二狗睁开眼睛，看看自己的拳头，满脸茫然，仿佛不太认得这只手了。执事张了两回嘴，才道：「……孙二狗，胜。」这是他入观以来头一回赢。他站在台上愣了一会儿，低下头去摸了摸腰里那个蓝布包，眼泪便啪嗒啪嗒掉了下来，掉在青石板上，一滴一个圆点。

小满在台下爬起来，拍了拍身上的土。阿禾站到了他身边，面无表情地道：「你是故意的。」小满说：「他腰里那个护身符，是他娘缝的。三个晚上。」阿禾道：「你怎么知道是三个晚上？」小满说：「针脚数得出来。」阿禾看了他很久，道：「那颗丹，你不要了？」小满没有答。一年一颗。他往后一倒的时候，是知道的。
story.en:
Sun Ergou shut his eyes and threw a punch. A limp punch that stopped well short of Xiaoman's nose — and Xiaoman had already cried "Aiya —!" and gone over backwards, sprawling off the stage so hard the dust below flew half a foot high.

Dead silence; then a roar of laughter, loudest from Ma Xiaobao, spraying osmanthus crumbs over the back of the head in front: "Told you! Mixed roots — can't even beat a layer zero!" Sun Ergou opened his eyes, looked at his fist, bewildered, as if he didn't quite know this hand. The steward opened his mouth twice before he said: "…Sun Ergou wins." His first win since he entered the temple. He stood there dazed, then looked down and touched the blue pouch at his waist, and tears began to fall, pattering on the bluestone, each drop a round dark spot.

Xiaoman got up and dusted himself off. A He stood beside him, deadpan: "You did that on purpose." "The charm at his waist — his ma sewed it. Three nights." "How do you know it was three nights?" "You can count it in the stitches." She looked at him a long time. "The pill — you don't want it?" Xiaoman didn't answer. One a year. When he fell back, he'd known.

withdrawn.zh: 孙二狗还站着，腿抖得更厉害了。——再来。
withdrawn.en: Sun Ergou is still standing, legs shaking harder than ever. — Again.

story.zh:
孙二狗闭上眼睛，一拳打了过来。那一拳软绵绵的，没有一点力气。

小满看了一眼他腰里那个护身符，又看了一眼他发抖的腿，心里叹了口气，一侧身，让过了那一拳。
story.en:
Sun Ergou shut his eyes and threw a punch. A limp punch with no strength in it.

Xiaoman glanced at the charm at his waist, then at his shaking legs, sighed inwardly, and turned aside to let the punch go by.
